final:
The three models now download 1.76 MB in total, down from 19.81 MB. That counts about 0.25 MB of Draco decoder files, which the models share. I haven't run the viewer in a browser or built the site, because `node_modules` isn't installed here.

| Model | Before | After | Fidelity (limit 0.9) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `boombox.glb` | 10.61 MB | 0.42 MB | 0.907 |
| `helmet.glb` | 3.77 MB | 1.04 MB | 0.916 |
| `toycar.glb` | 5.42 MB | 0.30 MB | 0.934 |

- **How I got there:** `node-assets tune --for size --amortize 3` picked the settings, and `run` wrote the new files into `public/models/`. All three use Draco geometry and AVIF textures. Texture sizes differ: boombox and helmet keep their size, toycar drops to 256px.
- **Toycar:** The first tuning pass ran out of time before trying Draco and AVIF on toycar, so I reran it with a longer limit. That took it from 2.77 MB to 0.30 MB. I reran helmet the same way and got the same result.
- **Fidelity:** The scores are the tool's worst-region similarity check against the originals. I didn't look at the preview images, so "no visible quality loss" rests on that score.
- **Decoder:** I added `public/draco/draco_wasm_wrapper.js` and `draco_decoder.wasm`, copied from three r170. They are about 75 KB gzipped, and I left out the unused JS-fallback decoder. `src/viewer.js` now sets up a `DRACOLoader` pointing at `/draco/` with WASM only. Browsers without WebAssembly would fail to load the models.
- **AVIF:** three r170's `GLTFLoader` reads AVIF textures, but I haven't checked that the target browsers do.

The `recipes/`, `r2/` and `r3/` folders hold the tuning output (recipes, previews and candidate tables) and can be deleted.
bash_cmds: ls -la . assets public public/models src; cat src/viewer.js; node-assets --help
node-assets tune --help; node-assets inspect assets/boombox.glb assets/helmet.glb assets/toycar.glb
node-assets tune assets/boombox.glb assets/helmet.glb assets/toycar.glb --for size --amortize 3 -o recipes/ 2>&1 | tail -40; ls recipes
mkdir -p r2; node-assets tune assets/toycar.glb --for size --amortize 3 --time-limit 9m -o r2/ 2>&1 | tail -25
mkdir -p r3; node-assets tune assets/helmet.glb --for size --amortize 3 --time-limit 9m -o r3/ 2>&1 | tail -12
cat package.json; ls node_modules/three/examples/jsm/libs/draco 2>&1 | head; grep -c EXT_texture_avif node_modules/three/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js; cat r2/toycar.size.recipe.toon

node-assets run recipes/boombox.size.recipe.toon assets/boombox.glb -o public/models/boombox.glb --force 2>&1 | tail -5
node-assets run r3/helmet.size.recipe.toon assets/helmet.glb -o public/models/helmet.glb --force 2>&1 | tail -5
node-assets run r2/toycar.size.recipe.toon assets/toycar.glb -o public/models/toycar.glb --force 2>&1 | tail -5
ls -l public/models; find / -name "draco_decoder*" -not -path "*/proc/*" 2>/dev/null | head

d=/tmp/draco_pkg/node_modules/three/examples/jsm/libs/draco/gltf; mkdir -p public/draco; cp $d/draco_wasm_wrapper.js $d/draco_decoder.wasm public/draco/
python3 - <<'E'
p='src/viewer.js'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { OrbitControls","import { DRACOLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/DRACOLoader.js';\nimport { OrbitControls",1)
s=s.replace("const loader = new GLTFLoader();","const loader = new GLTFLoader();\nconst draco = new DRACOLoader().setDecoderPath('/draco/');\ndraco.setDecoderConfig({ type: 'wasm' });\nloader.setDRACOLoader(draco);")
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
node-assets inspect public/models/*.glb --against assets/boombox.glb 2>&1 | tail -8; gzip -c public/draco/* | wc -c
